mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coding_test_session (member_id, difficulty, problem_text, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{difficulty}, #{problemText}, 'IN_PROGRESS')
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, difficulty, problem_text, status, created_at FROM coding_test_session WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coding_test_session WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ANSWERED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coding_test_session WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND created_at >= CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coding_test_session WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)
